fields.name: NoEmailAlert

Email is required in order for patients to complete their new patient paperwork.


Please assure the patient this is the reason we need their email.


If patient provides email, please just uncheck the box above.


If patient is still not able to provide email, please proceed and alert patient they will need to arrive to the appointment early in order to fill out their paperwork manually.

fields.fieldText:
I’m going to send you an email with a link to sign up for our patient portal, Breeze.


You can download the app on your phone or tablet, where you’ll be able to see your appointment. If you click on the appointment to preregister for your appointment, it will prompt you to fill out all of the paperwork ahead of time.


﻿If you are unable to fill out the paperwork beforehand, please arrive 30 minutes prior to your appointment and we will be sure to assist you.
